column1: # Experiment 2 — menu session → initial distractor (L) counts per panel.
# Both panels always contain a T; the session changes how many L are on each side.
# Changing the session number changes the proportion. session_run (repetition) does not.
# Sessions 6–10 repeat the same ratios as sessions 1–5.
#   ratio_label   — design label written to output (e.g. 20vs60)
#   n_L_left      — initial number of L letters on the left panel
#   n_L_right     — initial number of L letters on the right panel
#   correctkey    — metadata only; does NOT place T on one side (both sides have T)
#   duration_s    — planned continuous-session length in seconds (override: FORR_EXP2_DURATION_S)
